## Verdict

Looks good — a one-line lockfile normalization with no dependency version or integrity change.

## Narrative

This PR only touches `package-lock.json` (+1/−1). The diff adds a `resolved` URL on the existing `left-pad@1.3.0` entry while leaving `version` and `integrity` unchanged. That matches the stated intent (regenerate/normalize the lockfile after `npm install` with the same `package.json`).

Lockfiles are treated as generated artefacts in this review path, so the contents were not line-audited beyond confirming the patch is a single-field normalize rather than a version bump, integrity swap, or new package introduction. No application source, workflow, or manifest files changed alongside it.

## Release decision

**Recommendation:** approve
